nix-daemon-throttle-2026-10-22: max-jobs bounds concurrent builds but NOT CPU share, and nix-daemon only re-reads /etc/nix/nix.conf at start (written by activation) — a running rebuild uses the PREVIOUS generation's values (observed: config max-jobs=4/cores=6 while live daemon reported max-jobs=32/cores=0, cores=0 meaning unlimited, load avg 80 on 32 threads). Fix: systemd.services.nix-daemon.serviceConfig = { CPUWeight = 15; IOWeight = 40; }. Runtime relief without killing a build: systemctl set-property --runtime nix-daemon.service CPUWeight=15 IOWeight=40. Rejected nix.daemonCPUSchedPolicy='idle' (SCHED_IDLE also hits activation builds, can starve the switch). Hard-cap alternative CPUQuota=1400%. See .opencode/context/cuda-build-strategy.md, ADR-020.
